old_step: 6.1 Each cell is now its nonzero simple form quotient, absolutely simple, and all these cells are pairwise distinct and exhaust the simple modules by [[thm-nonzero-cell-heads-classify-the-simple-modules-of-a-cellular-algebra]]. Thus the split semisimple quotient $H/J(H)$ has dimension $\sum_\lambda |\operatorname{Std}(\lambda)|^2$. This equals $\dim H$ because the Murphy cellular basis has exactly one element for each pair of standard tableaux of the same shape ([[thm-murphy-tableau-elements-form-a-cellular-basis]]). Hence $J(H)=0$, $H$ is split semisimple, and the direct sum of all its simple cell modules is faithful. On that faithful module the global Lagrange products of the Statement are the orthogonal projectors from step 2.1, with different shapes having disjoint tuples by step 1.1. Therefore $F_sF_t=\delta_{st}F_t$ holds in $H$ itself, proving the global idempotents. This argument proves only the separated range and does not assert a finite-$e$ nonzero-label criterion when $e\le n$. [step 5.1, step 2.1, step 1.1, algebra]
new_step: 6.1 Prove faithfulness directly from the cell action. Write $W_\mu=S^\mu_{\mathrm M}$. If $\mu\not\unrhd\lambda$, then $H^{\unrhd\mu}\cap H^{\unrhd\lambda}\subseteq H^{\rhd\mu}$: the common Murphy basis shapes dominate both labels and none can equal $\mu$. For a shape-$\lambda$ element $b$, the product $m^\mu_{tt}b$ lies in this intersection, so $b$ acts as zero on $W_\mu$. Order the finite shape set by a linear extension of dominance. The linear right-action map $\Phi:H\to\bigoplus_\mu\operatorname{End}_F(W_\mu)$ is therefore block triangular, with columns grouped by Murphy shape and rows by cell module. In its shape-$\lambda$ diagonal block, [F5] sends $m^\lambda_{ab}$ to $w\mapsto\langle w,m_a\rangle_\lambda m_b$. The nonsingularity proved in step 5.1 means that the functionals $\langle -,m_a\rangle_\lambda$ form a dual-space basis. These rank-one operators consequently form a basis of $\operatorname{End}_F(W_\lambda)$, so every diagonal block is invertible. Block triangular elimination makes $\Phi$ a linear isomorphism. In particular the sum of the cells is faithful. With ordinary endomorphism composition, right action gives an algebra isomorphism $H^{\mathrm{op}}\cong\prod_\mu\operatorname{End}_F(W_\mu)$; transposition identifies each matrix algebra's opposite with itself, so $H$ is split semisimple. This establishes the claimed conclusion without a radical-quotient dimension inference. On the faithful sum, the global Lagrange products of the Statement act as the projectors of step 2.1; tableaux of different shapes have disjoint residue tuples by step 1.1. Hence $F_sF_t=\delta_{st}F_t$ in $H$. This proves the global idempotents only for $e>n$ and asserts no finite-$e$ nonzero-label criterion for $e\le n$. [F5, step 5.1, step 2.1, step 1.1, algebra]
new_fact: [F5] The Murphy elements $m^\lambda_{ab}$ form a cellular basis; the upward dominance spans $H^{\unrhd\lambda}$ and $H^{\rhd\lambda}$ are two-sided ideals ([[thm-murphy-tableau-elements-form-a-cellular-basis]]). Their own-cell action is $w m^\lambda_{ab}=\langle w,m_a\rangle_\lambda m_b$ ([[lem-cell-form-is-associative-and-its-radical-is-a-submodule]]).
